decision: ADR-023 §2.1/§3: deterministic protective check on each inbound consumer message, in the same transaction as its persistence; no model call. A refuse or uncertain rule hit restricts contact (uncertain is restricted too: when in doubt, restrict). Exclusions first remove clearly non-contact phrases (wrong goods, shipping, discounts, change) from the text; the rules are matched on what remains. Patterns are PostgreSQL ARE, case-insensitive. A new version is a new file and a new published row; versions are never edited.

refuse.pattern: (不要|别|不用|勿|请勿|不必|甭)\s*(再|在|继续)?\s*(给我|跟我|向我|和我|对我|找我)?\s*(发|打|推送|推|联系|打扰|骚扰|找|call|text)
(退订|取消订阅|unsubscribe|拉黑|屏蔽你们|删除我的(号码|手机号|联系方式))
(再|继续)\s*(发|打|联系|骚扰|推送).{0,8}(投诉|报警|举报|起诉)

uncertain.pattern: (少|别老|别总|不要老|不要总|别一直|不要一直)\s*(给我)?\s*(发|打|联系|推)
(烦死了|很烦|太烦了|别烦我|不胜其烦)

exclusions.pattern: (发|寄)\s*(错|漏|顺丰|快递|货|过来|到)
